claims.value: Photograph (black and white); carving in stone, in-situ, of a bird-man; Orongo, Easter Island.

notes.text: This British Museum catalogue record describes a photograph attributed to Katherine Maria Routledge, dated circa 1919. It is registered as a documentary source, not as a physical Rapa Nui artefact, and no image is published. The complete Description and the photograph's inscription identify an in-situ bird-man carving at Orongo; the record does not identify the individual carving as a separate MoSA object.
